TNK PROGRESSION — 1.1.8

Minecraft 1.21.1 · NeoForge 21.1.262+ · Java 21

Prestige levels 101–105

Reaching level 100 reveals five prestige levels, each with a gold-to-purple badge. Every prestige level awards five skill points for a maximum of 200 at level 105. Characters who have already reached level 100 can earn prestige XP immediately.

  • Level 100 → 101 costs 1,000,000 XP.
  • Level 101 → 102 costs 1,200,000 XP.
  • Level 102 → 103 costs 1,400,000 XP.
  • Level 103 → 104 costs 1,600,000 XP.
  • Level 104 → 105 costs the entire amount needed to reach level 104 on your active XP curve. On the default curve, that final level costs 10,150,000 XP, bringing the total to 20,300,000 XP.

The Character screen and HUD show prestige XP and levels as you earn them. Mob scaling and loot use campaign levels through 100.

Eternal Sovereign

Level 105 automatically unlocks the Eternal Sovereign title and its gold-to-purple badge. Its permanent benefits apply with any cosmetic or passive title equipped:

  • 20% faster mining.
  • 20% less damage from hits affected by Resistance.
  • 20% more maximum mana with Iron’s Spells or Ars Nouveau.

Existing level-105 characters receive the title and benefits on login.

Update the server and clients together.
